name: Melancholytron
description: Melancholytron is an art and hardware project by FRAKnoise, presenting an illustrated book about melancholy paired with a custom desktop synthesizer. Led by concept artist and sound designer Allard Krijger, with contributions from Joran Jessurun (software), Bram Bos (audio engine), Edwin van den Oetelaar (circuitry), and Roy Gilsing (industrial design). Based in the Netherlands.
